description: Website Availability and Login Page Validation
expected_result: Page loads successfully; title contains 'CRCE Leave Portal'; heading 'Student Portal' is visible; login form with email field, password field, and enabled Login button is present and usable.
actual_result: Page loaded successfully. Title: 'CRCE Leave Portal — Login'. Heading: 'Student Portal'. Email input, password input, and enabled Login button confirmed present.

expected_result: Invalid credentials are submitted; the application rejects them; an error toast message is displayed; user is NOT granted access and remains on the login page.
actual_result: Invalid credentials rejected. Error toast displayed: 'Invalid email or password'. Access denied, user remains on login page (URL: 'https://leave-portal-zeta.vercel.app/?logout=1').
